questions.title: Polymorphism
questions.description: Which mechanism allows Java to resolve method calls at runtime based on the actual object type rather than the reference type?
questions.explanation: Dynamic method dispatch (or dynamic binding) is how Java implements runtime polymorphism via method overriding.

questions.title: Exception Hierarchy
questions.description: Which of the following is NOT a checked exception in Java?
questions.explanation: RuntimeException and its subclasses (like NullPointerException) are unchecked exceptions.

questions.title: Abstract Classes vs Interfaces
questions.description: Which of the following statements are true regarding Abstract Classes and Interfaces in Java 8+? (Select all that apply)

options.text: A class can extend only one abstract class, but implement multiple interfaces.
Interfaces can have default and static methods.
A class must implement all methods of an interface unless it is declared abstract.

questions.title: Count Vowels
questions.description: Write a program that reads a single string and prints the total number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in it. Ignore case.
questions.constraints:
1 <= string length <= 1000
Input will contain only letters (a-z, A-Z).
questions.inputFormat: A single word or sentence string.

questions.title: Factorial Calculator
questions.description:
Read a positive integer N and print its factorial (N!).
Note: Factorials can get very large very quickly. Use `long` instead of `int`.
